outcome.technical: Copied the reviewed draft fixture into tests/fixtures/repos/python-api/ (15 files: README marking it a test fixture, pyproject, FastAPI app/main.py, Flask app/admin.py, Django shop/urls.py and shop/models.py, SQLAlchemy app/models.py, Pydantic app/schemas.py, two Alembic migrations, app/reports.py raw SQL, app/clients.py HTTP calls, app/sidefx.py import-time canary). Wrote tests/prescan-python.test.mjs first (8 cases py1-py8), saw it fail (module not found), then implemented scripts/lib/prescan/python.mjs: a mini lexer (string literals, comments, masked copy) plus regex/paren-matching extractors; exports extractPython(files, read) and a default plug-in {id:'python', detect(inventory), extract}. Fragment: {scanned, routes, entities, schemas, migrations, sqlTables, httpCalls, skipped{kind:n}, truncated{kind:n}}; every item has evidence:[{path, lines}], sorted by path then line, capped at 300 per kind. Constants and '+' chains of string literals are resolved; unresolvable shapes (Django include(), non-literal route/URL/table, f-string SQL table, unknown op, bulk_insert with non-literal table, non-literal __tablename__) are counted in skipped and never guessed; a Django table name is null unless Meta.db_table is given. Ran `node --test tests/prescan-python.test.mjs`: 8 pass, 0 fail. The full `node --test` gate was not run (runsGate own-tests).
